## Developer Console

**Author:** Gravitr

**Description:** Unlocks most of the developer commands/cheats in the console. These can be used to display AI companions, paths, obstacles, events, scripting zones, and more.

To use, replace your `Game.exe` in the game folder with this file (make a backup of the original `Game.exe` first).

Console command list: [PDF](https://rhmods.com/content/uploads/Console-command-list.pdf)
